slice: wave: a packet's cooldown comes from the cache at the rank it is cast
rule: R-17: a correction lands against the committed baselines plus a committed allowlist of the paths it declares it will move. This receipt is the full-coverage campaign's, and it supersedes one pair a closed campaign's receipt still names — expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-rearm.json declares this key moving 848.8 -> 731.8, and that slice did move it there. This slice moved it again.
what_moved: Lulu's outgoing total in the cleaver_bloodsong roster, 731.8 -> 733.5, and the 1.7 damage arriving on Aatrox, 4041.9 -> 4043.6. The second is the first: an ally's extra cast is damage the enemy takes.
why: The packet compiler stored a rank-1 cooldown as a scalar and served it at every rank, so Lulu's Whimsy waited 10 seconds where the cache falls to 8 by rank 3. A shorter cooldown fits another cast inside the roster window, and her outgoing rises by that cast's share. The same defect held 107 slots across 61 champions; this is the one of them the exact coupled baseline prices.
how_to_reproduce: python scripts/golden_snapshot.py capture-coupled --exact scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json, then read coupled_scenarios/cleaver_bloodsong_roster/combat/1:ally:Lulu/outgoing.
